apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(cards): round poster art to the card radius (`a109087b`)
- fix(posters): hide base art once textless art is ready and move quality tags top-left (`7cc0d549`)
- feat(posters): wider diagonal sash and dark star on light band (`5151d626`)
- feat(player): pick Anime4K mode from a list (`48152e3b`)
- feat(shortcuts): add gamepad rebinding and drop the watch together shortcut (`96bbe89a`)
- feat(settings): draw shortcuts as keycaps with controller glyphs (`1774e9d7`)
- fix(posters): read awards from MDBList text, push enrichment once GPU is ready, add light score band (`acb28558`)
- feat(posters): draw quality tags as plain text with dividers and add text shadow (`44cd8a2d`)
- feat(posters): use bold display font, larger labels and soft shadows on overlays (`63d5c5ac`)
- feat(posters): add overlay presets (`17418194`)
- feat(posters): draw sashes on landscape cards (`7344974f`)
- feat(posters): add release date disc for upcoming movies (`a3495965`)
- feat(posters): add textless art, age rating country, trending source and mal ids (`df7cd32c`)
- feat(posters): add weighted multi-source score and rating logos on posters (`422d4512`)
- feat(posters): add colored band and clean score styles, top fade and unreleased muting (`a920f3bd`)
- feat(posters): add notch, chip and edge sash styles with more sash types (`3ad3382f`)
- feat(settings): redesign desktop settings with sliders, About page and icon tiles (`8df90e9f`)
- fix(home): count only new episodes after th
